thread:
emma: Quick heads-up  I'm assembling a short migration doc for Optimize covering: new batch API, pragmatic KV prefetch recipes, and a tiny quant-profile YAML. Need quick eyes on snippets + a link sweep before I open a draft PR.
raj: I can review snippets. Please include both JS and Python KV examples and a one-paragraph rollout checklist.
olivia: I'll own the quant snippet. Any preference on dtype? I'd rather show one conservative and call out a bolder example in a comment.
emma: Conservative is good. Also want a short 'when not to prefetch' note and an observability checklist. Keep everything copy-paste ready.
miko: Draft of the batch/auth snippet (py) -- will include in the doc: 
```py
# v1 (old)
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['OLD_API'])
out = client.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', prompt=p, batch_size=12)

# v2 (new)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])
out = rc.text.generate(model='redwood-opt-3b', inputs=[p1, p2], max_tokens=160, batch_hint=6)
```
raj: Nice. Add a 1-line mapping note: "batch_size -> batch_hint; api_key -> token".
olivia: Quant YAML (conservative) below. I'll annotate in the doc to mention hardware variance.
```yaml
quant_profile:
  model: redwood-opt-3b
  dtype: q4_0
  perf_targets:
    latency_p95_ms: 140
    throughput_rps: 30
  metrics_to_watch:
    - answer_exact_match
    - latency_p95_ms
  fallback_policy: route_to_nonquant
```
olivia: Comment to include with snippet: "q4_0 is a conservative starting point; q5_k/q6_k may be viable on A100s but test on a representative eval set."
emma: KV prefetch snippets please (JS + py). Keep limit examples and a note to cap by median_seq_len * 2.
raj: JS one-liner:
```js
// prefetch up to 64 keys
await client.kv.prefetch(keys, {limit: 64});
```
raj: Python async sketch:
```py
async def prefetch(keys, limit=64):
    window = keys[:limit]
    await client.kv.prefetch(window)
```
emma: Add UX note: "Avoid prefetch for very short sequences (<32 tokens): caching or no-op is cheaper."
miko: Observability checklist to paste in doc: emit prefetch_hit_rate, prefetch_queue_depth, model_variant_used; track answer_exact_match delta and latency_p95; set automatic fallback when quality drops >2 or latency +20%.
olivia: Rollout checklist (put at top of doc): 1) run representative smoke eval 2) canary 5-10% for 24h 3) compare metrics vs baseline 4) enable auto-fallback on defined thresholds.

emma: Great, thanks team. I'll post the PR link in this thread when it's ready. :sparkles:
